data_policy_contract_notes: The Phaseo standard Token Factory route is configured with Nebius Zero Data Retention. Under the public terms, ZDR disables post-processing storage and speculative-decoding use for request content; the generic public route otherwise permits that processing.
residency_notes: The live public catalog assigns each current Base route to eu-north1 (Finland), eu-west2 (France), uk-south1 (United Kingdom), or us-central1 (United States). These are execution placements reported for the public endpoints, not user-selectable residency guarantees.
prompt_training_notes: The Phaseo standard Token Factory route has ZDR enabled, so request inputs and outputs are not stored after processing or used for speculative-decoding training. Nebius's public terms describe that processing for routes without ZDR.

sources.notes: Documents the OpenAI-compatible API base URL and Bearer authentication.
Complete live first-party Base-flavor route catalog used to reconcile model IDs, lifecycle, regions, modalities, features, quantization, context, and prices with zero unaccounted routes.

Section 7 says Nebius may host, cache, store, and modify Inputs and Outputs and collects/processes them to train smaller speculative-decoding models; ZDR is the account control that disables that processing for the configured route.

verification.notes: Verified OpenAI Chat, Responses, and Embeddings transports plus all 30 current Base-flavor routes in the live public catalog. The standard Phaseo Token Factory route is configured with ZDR enabled, based on the account configuration.
